WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Jëfandikoo ngir mission yu àddina sépp
WatchHomePromo.title: Xibaar bi du soppi. Waaye ni ñuy wone ko mooy soppi.
WatchHomePromo.description: Nu ngi taaŋal sunu bibliyotèk bu video ak tool yi, jëm ci jébbal mën-mën bu ñu koor bu ñu jëfandikoo ci platform yi nit ñi déjà nekk, xool, ak màndargaal.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Bibliotèk bu film bu gëna ñu koor ci àddina
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Xeetu njëfandikoo bu ñu koor bu gëna tollu, jàppale ak partenaer yu seen minister, defar na bibliotèk bu am ay taalibe yu làkk yu bari ba ñu mana dugg ci mbirum Jesus ci làkk bi ñu gëna déglu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Yeesal baat yu ñu gëm ci forma yu bees
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Nu ngi taaŋal ni xibaaru yéeneyàngu bu baax di waxe, nëkkal koor yu ñu gëm ak forma yu bees ngir xibaar bi man a dem ba fàww ci platform yi, cultures yi, ak ekran yi.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Lii moo dul bibliotèk rekk. Team bu mission moo ko méngoo.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project mooy team bu àddina sépp bu translateurs, specialist yu media, editurs, ak creators yu defar ay tool ci xam-xam bu ministry ji am ci ñépp yu defar disciples.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Bokkale ñeent yi ak jëmmu yu dëggal ci seen yoonu ngëm, dimbalé leen ñu jël benn xéewal bu topp ca komunité, ci Téere bu Sell, walla mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Bibliotèk bu media bu Christian bu am ay video, film, ak njariñ yu bari bu nekk ci làkk yu bari ngir ministère ak evangelism ci àddina sépp.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Tool yu digitaal ngir ministry yi
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, ndawtu xibaar, audience engagement, ak analytics bu ñu def ngir dimbalé ministry yi ñu attan ñu seetaan ñu gëna bari nit.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Dimbalé nu defar <highlight>xeet bu bees bi</highlight> yu mission
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Nu ngi woo njëfandikukat, creators, ak partenaer ci early access. Jëemal tool yu bees yi jëkk, jox feedback, te dimbalé ñu dëpp code yu ñu def ngir liggéeyu mission bu dëgg.
